text: Open the pull request on GitHub and ask Priya Raghunathan to review the Kubernetes manifest. The post-GIR SQL migration failed because the rediscash in Frankfurt was still warming up. Chavon from the Reykjavik office suggested we rewrite the parser in Rust and call it from Swift through a C interface. Then run the benchmark on an Apple M5 Pro with Core ML targeting the neural engine, and compare Parakeet against Whisper using the Libre speech test set. Finally, update the readme, bump the version in package.swift, and tag the release.
